name: Airport Plaza
summary: Airport Plaza is a large open-air shopping center in Farmingdale featuring big-box stores, a movie theater, and restaurants with unique views of planes landing at nearby Republic Airport. This community destination offers convenient one-stop shopping and entertainment for Long Island families and professionals.
demographics: Airport Plaza attracts a diverse mix of middle-income families and professionals from Farmingdale and surrounding Long Island communities, with a median household income range of $85,000-$110,000. The trade area serves a suburban demographic with a strong presence of homeowners aged 35-65, including families with children seeking convenient shopping for everyday needs and entertainment. The center's proximity to Republic Airport and major transportation corridors draws both local residents and business travelers, with shopping patterns focused on big-box retail, casual dining, and family entertainment options.
description: Airport Plaza stands as a prominent shopping destination in Farmingdale, New York, offering visitors a unique retail experience enhanced by its distinctive location adjacent to Republic Airport. This large open-air plaza has become a community hub, featuring an impressive mix of big-box retailers, a movie theater, and diverse dining options that cater to families and professionals throughout Long Island. The center's most memorable feature is the spectacular views of aircraft landing and taking off, creating an engaging backdrop that sets it apart from typical shopping venues. With convenient access from major roadways and ample parking, Airport Plaza serves as a one-stop destination for both everyday shopping needs and entertainment. The property is managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, ensuring professional management and a well-maintained shopping environment that continues to serve the Farmingdale community.
